visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a black cardigan and blue jeans, crouches on a tiled floor in an indoor space. She points excitedly at a black PC case on the floor, looking into the lens with a wide smile and expressive facial movements. (2) The scene shifts to a person in a grey hoodie with a paper printout of an NVIDIA RTX graphics card taped over their head. This 'GPU character' stands next to the PC case, pointing vigorously at the back IO panel, specifically the upper motherboard ports. Bright, radiating white emphasis lines appear around them to highlight their statement. (3) A sequence of clips follows: the short-haired woman sits at a desk in an office setting waving at the camera; then she sits in a red and black gaming chair wearing large blue headphones looking bored. Next, the person with the GPU mask is seen lying on a red beanbag being tucked in with a blanket by someone else; they have another paper sign on their head that says 'CPU 內顯'. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the back of the PC case. A hand reaches in and moves a black display cable from the top motherboard ports to the lower horizontal ports on the dedicated graphics card. The GPU-headed character returns, pointing at the camera in a teaching gesture. Finally, the woman from the first scene is back, looking up from her crouching position with a serious yet playful gaze.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 新顯卡 新顯卡. [Variety]: 嗚呼. (2) [Subtitle]: (聽起來好痛). (3) [Subtitle]: 你插錯洞了. (4) [Subtitle]: 這是很多人不小心會犯的錯誤. (5) [Subtitle]: 如果你的電腦有獨立顯卡的話. (6) [Subtitle]: 千萬不要把螢幕線材插在上面的洞. (7) [Subtitle]: 上面這邊是主機板的顯示. (8) [Subtitle]: 插在這邊 要嘛你沒內顯 螢幕沒畫面. (9) [Subtitle]: 要嘛雖然有內顯有畫面 但效能就不會有你買的 RTX 5070 80、90 好. (10) [Subtitle]: 等於你買了貴貴的獨立顯卡 卻完全沒在用它. (11) [Subtitle]: 這跟買了空氣清淨機 卻沒拆濾網包裝一樣. (12) [Subtitle]: 不要鬧了 請你立刻把線換到下面獨顯的洞. (13) [Subtitle]: 這樣才可以好好享受自己買的顯卡喔!. (14) [Subtitle]: 知道了嗎?. [Variety]: (留言說知道了).

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator with short hair, 1 female assistant appearing in a hoodie with a mask.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with straight short black hair and bangs, wearing a black knit cardigan over a dark top and light blue denim jeans.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An indoor office/studio environment featuring shelves with boxes, a red and black gaming chair, computer desks with monitors and keyboards, and large red beanbags. There are also PC components and boxes visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, excited female exclamation '新顯卡 新顯卡' (New graphics card), accompanied by a high-energy electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat. (2) A sharp, loud impact SFX occurs as if something hit a surface hard, transitioning into the main narration. (3) The female narrator's voice becomes professional yet energetic, delivering a rapid-fire explanation of PC cable connections. Short 'pop' and 'whoosh' SFX punctuate her points during the montage. The BGM remains constant, providing a rhythmic backdrop to her speech. (4) A mechanical 'click' sound is synchronized with the visual of the display cable being plugged into the GPU port. The narrator's tone rises at the end, asking '知道了嗎?' (Got it?), followed by a final soft, low-volume '知道了' (I got it) response.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Educational Montage -> Solution -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate computer users on the correct way to connect monitor cables when a dedicated graphics card is present, preventing performance loss or display issues through a humorous and engaging tutorial.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Mentioning NVIDIA RTX series in an educational context, though not explicitly a paid promotion for a specific model.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a 'personified GPU' mascot to add humor and visual interest to a basic technical tip, making it highly shareable for tech communities.
